subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` remain a built-in-OpenClaw-only setting that rejects plugin harness runs, or become a capability that supporting harnesses can implement?
rationale: The current hardcoded rejection is intentional and documented, but it creates permanent public config semantics and operator-visible failure behavior that code review cannot approve without owner intent.

options.title: Approve built-in-only scope
options.body: Keep the fail-fast behavior for plugin harnesses, document it as an intentional first-version restriction, and require exact-head upgrade and live-run proof.

options.title: Add a harness capability
options.body: Expose a stable capability contract so supporting harnesses can enforce the same round limit without a hardcoded harness identifier.

options.title: Defer the public setting
options.body: Remove the config surface and keep the canonical issue open until permanent cross-harness semantics are agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve built-in-only scope
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-fast behavior for plugin harnesses, document it as an intentional first-version restriction, and require exact-head upgrade and live-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the current narrowing and built-in-only policy on this branch, making them the clearest available owner for confirming that product choice.
